remarks: Enjoy the Good Life! Welcome to maintenance-free luxury at 1206 Charlesgate Cir, a beautifully updated condo/townhome in Amherst’s highly sought-after Charlesgate Village with abundant community amenities and services. A welcoming exterior, private patio, and attractive curb appeal create a wonderful first impression. Fully renovated and completely move-in ready, this home offers stylish updates and everyday convenience in the top-rated Williamsville School District. Enter inside to brand-new luxury vinyl plank flooring and fresh paint throughout. The open-concept main floor flows seamlessly from the generous living room into a stunning, newly remodeled kitchen featuring brand-new appliances, exceptional cabinet storage, and abundant counter space. A convenient main-floor half bath adds functionality. Upstairs, bright bedrooms share a brand new glass-enclosed shower bathroom. Slide open the glass door to enjoy your private patio featuring new concrete, perfect for relaxing outdoors. The detached garage has a brand new Apollo floor coating for that extra touch. Ideally located near shopping, dining, entertainment, parks, and major roadways, this home combines updated luxury with low-maintenance living in a very desirable quiet Amherst location. Come enjoy the good life at Charlesgate Village!
